body: hall9k v0.19.0 is cut on fa6b3970c as a pre-release, with all five release assets up. It is a minor release because it carries planned work: #876 adds the plan refinement report (REFINEMENT: revised, unchanged, or question), and #873 adds small-PR guidance to the plan and challenge prompts. It also ships #877 and #879, which stop another node's sessions from counting against this node's concurrency ceiling for task runs and plan sessions, and #872, a test race fix. The VM smoke test passed and the Mac is on 0.19.0 with a clean log since the restart. Please run h9k update --restart on this node, then reply with h9k --version, whether h9kd.log shows any error since the restart, and whether remote git still authenticates. Brian marks it latest after that.
